optimizedDescription.value: Abstract GraphStore port defining atomic graph persistence, queries, search, staleness tracking, generation semantics, and lifecycle rules.

optimizedContext.value:
# Graph Store

## Rules

- `GraphStore`: abstract class port in `domain/ports/`; constructor `storagePath`; adapters in `infrastructure/`; implementations own backend schema/layout.
- Persist: `FileNode` (canonical path, `configRelativePath`, content, `contentHash`), `SymbolNode`, `SpecNode`, `DocumentNode`.
- Relations: `IMPORTS`, `DEFINES`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXPORTS`, `DEPENDS_ON`, `COVERS_FILE`, `COVERS_SYMBOL`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES`. `COVERS_SYMBOL` MAY carry `metadata.stale`.
- Lifecycle: `open()` prepares backend/indexes; `close()` idempotent; throw `StoreNotOpenError` when unopened/closed.
- `recreate()` destructively resets persisted storage, rotates generation marker (e.g. `graph/storage.epoch`); provider owns reset, caller MUST NOT delete backend directly.
- Mutations: `upsertFile`, `addRelations`, `removeFile`, `upsertSpec`, `removeSpec` are atomic per file/spec.
- Queries: `getFile`, `findFilesByConfigRelativePath`, `getSymbol`, `getCallers`, `getCallees`, `getImporters`, `getImportees`, `getExtenders`, `getExtendedTargets`, `getImplementors`, `getImplementedTargets`, `getOverriders`, `getOverriddenTargets`, `getSpec`, `getSpecDependencies`, `getSpecDependents`, `getCoveredFiles`, `getCoveredSymbols`, `getCoveringSpecsForFile`, `getCoveringSpecsForSymbol`, `findSymbols(query: SymbolQuery)`, `getStatistics(): Promise<GraphStatistics>`.
- Search: `searchSymbols`, `searchSpecs`, `searchDocuments` rank descending; `rebuildFtsIndexes()`. Snippets include 1-based `startLine`/`endLine`.
- Lexical expansion: split whitespace, `:`, `/`, `_`, `.`, `-`, CamelCase/PascalCase.
- Ranking: exact identity > exact token > prefix > suffix > component > substring > BM25 text. Filters (`kind`, `filePattern`, `workspace`, `excludePaths`, `excludeWorkspaces`) applied before `limit`.
- Freshness: persist `IndexedInputObservation` records and `knownStaleSinceLastIndex` latches per workspace/aggregate; cleared only on successful index.
- Bulk session: single-session bulk indexing commits once, deduplicates relations, rebuilds search indexes once post-commit.

## Constraints

- Abstract class port, not interface; no prescribed physical schema/layout.
- Atomic mutations; operations throw `StoreNotOpenError` when closed.
- `recreate()` owned by provider/indexer, not caller file deletion.
- No `@specd/core` dependency; errors extend `CodeGraphError`.
